then.text: The crab nods slowly and returns to a rock.

else.text: A hermit crab pushes a folded, damp bit of paper out from under a rock with one claw, and clacks. It reads: 'Ask the dive shop.'
A crab regards you with the unbothered air of a creature that lives between boulders the size of houses.

bvi_climber.text: I've crawled through four tunnels, waded two pools and lost a flip-flop. I'm told Devil's Bay is wonderful. I'm told I'll know when I'm there. I don't.
The rocks are granite, formed underground and exposed by weathering. Don't push one over. Please.
